properties.notes: The site has been occupied by a permanent structure but the remains have not sufficiently blended into the landscape over the process of time. It is in a location accessible to a centre and with reasonable accessibility to services and facilities and it is likely that constraints can be mitigated. Whilst nearby schools capacity is a constraint certain types of residential development would be possible without an increase in demand for school places. Furthermore the potential for expansion of the nearby schools is as yet undetermined.
